proof fn LogRangeMatchesQueue_drop_first<DT: Dispatch>(
    queue: Seq<ReqId>,
    log: Map<nat, LogEntry<DT>>,
    queueIndex: nat,
    logIndexLower: nat,
    logIndexUpper: nat,
    nodeId: nat,
    updates: Map<ReqId, UpdateState<DT>>,
)
    requires
        0 <= queueIndex < queue.len(),
        logIndexLower < logIndexUpper,
        LogContainsEntriesUpToHere(log, logIndexUpper),
        LogRangeMatchesQueue(queue, log, queueIndex, logIndexLower, logIndexUpper, nodeId, updates),
        log[logIndexLower].node_id == nodeId,
    ensures
        LogRangeMatchesQueue(queue, log, queueIndex + 1, logIndexLower + 1, logIndexUpper, nodeId, updates),
    decreases logIndexUpper - logIndexLower,
{
    reveal(LogRangeMatchesQueue);
    assert(log.contains_key(logIndexLower));
    assert(LogRangeMatchesQueue(queue, log, queueIndex + 1, logIndexLower + 1, logIndexUpper, nodeId, updates));
}
